\section[khaṭṭā]{\hi{खट्टा} (khaṭṭā) — sour}

\label{lesson:HI-C156-khatta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Hindi for fast, then the Hindi for slow.

Say \textbf{\hi{मुझे} \hi{चाय} \hi{पसंद} \hi{है}}. \textbf{\hi{पसंद}} is not a verb, and \textbf{\hi{मुझे}} means \emph{to me}.
\end{quote}

\section[(dialogue)]{Nature, animals and the body — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R156-first-pass-nature-animals-and-the-body}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for salty and spicy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a pigeon, a parrot, an owl, a butterfly, a fly
  \item a mosquito, an ant, a frog, a tortoise, a mouse
  \item an elbow, a wrist, a thumb, a fingernail, a cheek
  \item the chin, the tongue, the neck, the chest, the waist
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A pigeon? (\textbf{\hi{कबूतर}}, \emph{kabūtar}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\hi{तोता}}, \emph{totā}.) An owl? (\textbf{\hi{उल्लू}}, \emph{ullū}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\hi{तितली}}, \emph{titlī}.) A fly? (\textbf{\hi{मक्खी}}, \emph{makkhī}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\hi{मच्छर}}, \emph{macchar}.) An ant? (\textbf{\hi{चींटी}}, \emph{cīṇṭī}.) A frog? (\textbf{\hi{मेंढक}}, \emph{meṇḍhak}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{\hi{कछुआ}}, \emph{kachuā}.) A mouse? (\textbf{\hi{चूहा}}, \emph{cūhā}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\hi{कोहनी}}, \emph{kohnī}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\hi{कलाई}}, \emph{kalāī}.) A thumb? (\textbf{\hi{अंगूठा}}, \emph{aṅgūṭhā}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\hi{नाखून}}, \emph{nākhūn}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\hi{गाल}}, \emph{gāl}.) The chin? (\textbf{\hi{ठोड़ी}}, \emph{ṭhoṛī}.) The tongue? (\textbf{\hi{जीभ}}, \emph{jībh}.) The neck? (\textbf{\hi{गर्दन}}, \emph{gardan}.) The chest? (\textbf{\hi{छाती}}, \emph{chātī}.) The waist? (\textbf{\hi{कमर}}, \emph{kamar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The body and places — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R156-second-pass-the-body-and-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for blood and a post office.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item blood, a post office, a library, a temple, a mosque
  \item a garden, a field, a bridge, an office, a bank
  \item hot, wet, dry, heavy, light
  \item soft, hard, clean, dirty, fast
  \item slow, sour, bitter, salty, spicy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Blood? (\textbf{\hi{ख़ून}}, \emph{khūn}.) A post office? (\textbf{\hi{डाकघर}}, \emph{ḍākghar}.) A library? (\textbf{\hi{पुस्तकालय}}, \emph{pustakālay}.) A temple? (\textbf{\hi{मंदिर}}, \emph{mandir}.) A mosque? (\textbf{\hi{मस्जिद}}, \emph{masjid}.) A garden? (\textbf{\hi{बगीचा}}, \emph{bagīcā}.) A field? (\textbf{\hi{मैदान}}, \emph{maidān}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\hi{पुल}}, \emph{pul}.) An office? (\textbf{\hi{दफ़्तर}}, \emph{daftar}.) A bank? (\textbf{\hi{बैंक}}, \emph{baiṅk}.) Hot? (\textbf{\hi{गरम}}, \emph{garam}.) Wet? (\textbf{\hi{गीला}}, \emph{gīlā}.) Dry? (\textbf{\hi{सूखा}}, \emph{sūkhā}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\hi{भारी}}, \emph{bhārī}.) Light? (\textbf{\hi{हल्का}}, \emph{halkā}.) Soft? (\textbf{\hi{नरम}}, \emph{naram}.) Hard? (\textbf{\hi{सख़्त}}, \emph{sakht}.) Clean? (\textbf{\hi{साफ़}}, \emph{sāf}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\hi{गंदा}}, \emph{gandā}.) Fast? (\textbf{\hi{तेज़}}, \emph{tez}.) Slow? (\textbf{\hi{धीमा}}, \emph{dhīmā}.) Sour? (\textbf{\hi{खट्टा}}, \emph{khaṭṭā}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\hi{कड़वा}}, \emph{kaṛvā}.) Salty? (\textbf{\hi{नमकीन}}, \emph{namkīn}.) Spicy? (\textbf{\hi{तीखा}}, \emph{tīkhā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
